entities.summary: Tabita Berglund (b. 1989-03-28, Trondheim) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Trondheim and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
